root_cause_assessment: Two independent, non-overlapping blockers, not one: (1) Anthropic/Google/OpenAI OAuth — stored, structurally loadable in every tested path (default, standalone, standalone+empty-config-dir), yet rejected by all three providers (401/401/400) including through the normal fully-configured background-service path. Most consistent explanation given the ~2.5-month-stale auth.json and continuous service uptime without a refresh write: the stored OAuth credentials themselves are expired/revoked and require an interactive `opencode auth login <provider>` re-auth — a login/credential action explicitly out of scope for this diagnostic and for parent's non-interactive calls. (2) opencode/big-pickle Zen free tier — a separate, structural 403 entitlement gate restricting free-tier Zen models to the first-party OpenCode app context, independent of the OAuth issue and not resolvable via any CLI/API surface documented in --help output.
